claims.quote: Type locality is 'Mae Surin River, a branch of Mae Pai River, at Ban Huei Phan, Mae Hong Son, northwestern Thailand'.
The Mae Pai is itself a tributary of the Salween that joins the main river channel in the border state of Kayah, Myanmar.

regions.name: Salween
regions.quote: Endemic to the River Salween basin although the full extent of its distribution within the watershed is unclear.
